rationale: Unset and exact 1 automatically admit bounded occupied-feature SCF proposals. Admitted points avoid dense verification, while unsupported and near-stationary inputs retain live original-D work. The initializer permanently hands off to the original matrix target and resets the energy epoch before unchanged strict physical/canonical acceptance. DIIS may predict densities for at most six unsuccessful strict sweeps before being cleared, never certify a physical result. StrictAudit never receives provisional features. Explicit 0 and malformed controls remain matrix-only; automatic initializer selection is not a universal XC sensitivity certificate or an all-functional speedup claim.
revisit_condition: Revisit automatic admission if source-matched complete native cold/warm/moved E+F timing, semantic work or independent scientific gates expose a credible regression; retain explicit 0 rollback and the strict original-D target regardless of initializer policy.
